generalizations: This is an original purpose-and-turnaround schematic, not turn-by-turn navigation.
North-south spacing and the east-west city band are exaggerated for B6 label legibility.
No path is drawn from Wuquan Mountain to Lanshan, and no current cableway, bus, road, fare, gradient, or walking time is encoded.
Park centre and mountain anchors are orientation points, not gates, trailheads, boarding points, or accessibility evidence.
The three branches are alternatives; a failed weather, visibility, mobility, or descent check returns to the city-level route rather than another hill.
